newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa urges negotiation in Middle East.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa urges negotiation in Middle East.

text.p: South Africa urged Israelis and Palestinians to accept that only negotiations could lead to a lasting peace in the Middle East, while denouncing Wednesday's bombings in a crowded West Jerusalem market.

Calling on all parties to avoid any retaliation for the blasts, apparently the work of militant suicide bombers, Pretoria's Foreign Affairs department said in a statement it was committed to a resumption of the Middle East peace process.

"Notwithstanding the despicable nature of this atrocity... the time has undeniably come for all people of goodwill in the region to address their differences through dialogue and to accept the reality that the only road to a lasting and just peace lies through negotiation," the department said.
